concerns.text: SC-007 (Pearson r ≥ 0.5) and SC-008 (Cohen's d ≥ 0.5) are threshold success criteria, but no task ASSERTS or evaluates them against their thresholds — T008 only computes/reports the values, and T010's validation checks (a)–(d) cover reproduction, sensitivity, power, and runtime but omit SC-007/SC-008 pass/fail evaluation. Add an explicit check (e.g., in T010) so these criteria are covered by a task, not merely measured.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Task format and paths vs plan.md:Project Structure
concerns.text: Plan's source tree includes `src/parser/utils.py` and places tests under `tests/unit/` and `tests/contract/`; tasks use `code/src/` and a flat `code/tests/` layout and never task `parser/utils.py`. Harmless divergence, but a one-line note reconciling the layouts (or dropping utils.py) would keep plan-to-task traceability clean.
